svg.title: Clawd the pilot, jev-pilot's pet
svg.desc: Above the Claude Code prompt, Clawd shows what Claude is doing and its bubble says what Jev decided: thinking, reading a file, searching, running tests, flying when the effort is raised to max after two failures, writing the fix, then jumping rope and waving while idle.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: ❯ the checkout tests fail since the merge
● Fixed: the discount ran twice after the merge.
